name: Executive Order 14434: Inaugurating the Era of Super Intelligence
summary: Presidential order of 29 September 2026 replacing 'Artificial Intelligence' terminology with 'Super Intelligence' in federal agency communications and starting a 60 day process for a proposed statutory definition.
key_obligations: Executive departments use 'Super Intelligence'/'SI' in official correspondence, communications, websites, reports and policy documents, to the maximum extent permitted by law
Assistant to the President for Science and Technology to submit proposed legislative language for a federal definition within 60 days

timeline.note: Order signed (per the White House page).
